title: Mitraseeds: seed character matrix and analysis pipeline for South American Mitracarpus (Spermacoceae, Rubiaceae)
description:
Data and analysis code underlying the study of seed micromorphology in 27 South American species of Mitracarpus (Spermacoceae, Rubiaceae).

Contents: a self-contained R pipeline that reproduces every analysis, figure and table in the paper from the raw character matrix; the same matrix as a documented spreadsheet, with the 52 character states, seed dimensions and biome assignments; and the supplementary figures as vector PDFs.

The nine characters are unordered qualitative traits. Analyses comprise Gower dissimilarity, UPGMA clustering with cophenetic correlation and character jackknife, silhouette widths with a PAM cross-check, PCoA with Cailliez correction and vector fitting, Multiple Correspondence Analysis, PERMANOVA and PERMDISP on matrices from which each grouping's defining characters were removed, Mantel and partial Mantel tests, Fisher exact tests, and an exhaustive search for the smallest subset of characters that still separates every species.

Each permutation test reseeds immediately before running, so every p-value is independent of the order in which the script is executed.
